def: OpenAI's family of generative pre-trained transformer models, from GPT-1 (2018) to the current generation, offered in tiers from flagship to fast and inexpensive.
practice: As of November 2026 the API flagships are GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6.1 Terra and GPT-6 Luna, roughly from most capable to most efficient; open-weight models ship separately as gpt-oss.
